about: Test data for src/lib/lichessRules.ts. 'games': the 6 rated Lichess games of abustrup that Lichess analysed, with Lichess's own evaluations and labels; opponents' names are left out. 'vectors': generated evals before and after a move with the verdicts of the pre-registered Python rule and of the Python mirror of Lichess's client rules in scripts/check-rule-parity.py.
gameFields: side = his colour; analysis[i] = Lichess's eval after ply i+1, White's point of view
